method: Assistant visual inspection of all 46 fixed-interval raw sample frames before inspecting candidate coordinates. Approximate centers, normally +/-2 px. User subsequently confirmed that COD nemesis/skull markers are valid target cues alongside circles; the two previously uncertain frames are included under this confirmed class scope. These are provisional visual reference labels, not independently human-reviewed or complete video ground truth. Allowed detection indices were assigned afterward by inspecting same-frame person boxes. Person association recall is conditional on the supplied person detector.
cue_scope: User-confirmed 2026-10-19: enemy circles and COD nemesis/skull symbols both qualify; health bars and diamond pings remain excluded. A skull is not interpreted as a dead target.
default: Every sample absent from positives was visually checked and has no visible enemy circle or nemesis/skull cue in the central crop. This does not mean no person is present.
